Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 1 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period.

3. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Specification Authenticity Requirement: The offered Desktop must strictly conform to the following specifications: # Processor: Intel Core i3, 14th Generation Or higher # RAM: 8 GB Or higher # Storage: 512 GB SSD # Monitor: 21.5" # Operating System: Windows 11 pro # Wi-Fi Connectivity 2. Model & Warranty Validation: The quoted desktop must come with a clearly mentioned 5 years onsite OEM warranty. This warranty detai l must be verifiable in the OEM’s official documentation or on the OEM’s official website 3. Manufacturer Authorization Form MAF: The bidder must upload a Bid-specific Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) issued by the OEM, addressed to the consignee as per bid details, and clearly mentioning the GeM Bid Number. Bids without t he required MAF will be treated as non-compliant and rejected. 4. Mandatory Product Declaration Letter: The bidder must upload a signed and stamped declaration on their official letterhead, confirming the make and model of the quoted desktop, complete technical specifications as per the bid, warranty and a firm co mmitment to deliver the items within 7 calendar days from the date of GeM contract generation. 5. Compliance at Final Delivery: All the above terms must be complied with at the time of final delivery. Once the GeM Contract is generate d, the seller is legally bound to supply the desktops as per the approved specifications. Failure to do so giv es the buyer the right to reject the bid, cancel the order, and take legal action as per GeM policies. .
